reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. Employer means where the donor works, not that the company gave money; corporations can't give directly to campaigns. Industry groups use simple keyword rules and may misclassify some donors.

votes.question: On Passage — National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027 (H R 8800)
votes.bill_title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027
votes.plain_language: This bill authorizes fiscal year 2027 military programs, troop levels, and related Energy Department national-security work. A Yea passes it in the House. A Nay votes against passage.

This vote would have sent that bill back to the Armed Services Committee with no rewrite attached. A Yea would have pulled it off the floor; a Nay left it up for the passage vote.

party_line.scope: House roll calls 1–323 of 2026 (323 votes, January 6, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the House Clerk.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
My friend @Jim_Jordan is the perfect choice to be our next House GOP leader. 

Things are already looking up!
Unmistakable good economic news - I know this Administration’s policies will deliver if given time. https://t.co/tfjkeePCNh

Major move today by @JDVance -- The VP's pledge to protect Americans from fraud is the right message at what is indisputably the right time. The Trump Administration is exposing the astonishing scope of fraud in America and delivering accountability where it is long overdue.

The truth is we all lose when taxpayers get fleeced, government benefits get stolen. and fraudsters go unpunished. Everyone should support this.

FACT: 

For five decades, Americans on American soil have shed blood and lost their lives at the hands of Iran and its terrorist proxies. Where the Obama and Biden Administrations appeased Tehran, paid them billions in bribes, and put them on a glide path to having nuclear weapons, President Trump has taken historic and concrete action to eliminate the nuclear threat, protect every inch of our homeland, and ensure Iran never threatens America or her allies ever again.

Very positive news.

States should never have tried to weaponize antitrust law and Paramount’s vision of increased production and a transformed entertainment economy ought to be given the opportunity to succeed. https://t.co/Z7uThXQMIR
Pitch perfect from @SpeakerJohnson https://t.co/et4mFCiRSy
Any time is the right time for accountability in the judiciary - and it’s overdue here. https://t.co/tjZYElf4pK

This is not a close call: AG Bonta is working to deliver a death blow to one of the most recognized industries in CA — taking Paramount’s 34K jobs (and perhaps more from WBD) with them. Even Gavin Newsom can see the lawsuits are a losing hand and the right agreement would be win-win.
https://t.co/XqW1Avg0bN

Five years ago today, 13 of our best and bravest service members were killed by a terror attack at Abbey Gate in Afghanistan. This was an unimaginable tragedy, but also a total failure of the Biden Administration.

We will never forget the fallen, and we will never stop fighting for the indefatigable Gold Star families who only want the transparent truth of what happened that day to their kids:

Staff Sergeant Ryan C. Knauss, USA; Staff Sergeant Darin Taylor Hoover, USMC; Sergeant Johanny Rosario Pichardo, USMC; Sergeant Nicole L. Gee, USMC; Corporal Hunter Lopez, USMC; Corporal Daegan W. Page, USMC; Corporal Humberto A. Sanchez, USMC; Lance Corporal David L. Espinoza, USMC; Lance Corporal Jared M. Schmitz, USMC; Lance Corporal Rylee J. McCollum, USMC; Lance Corporal Dylan R. Merola, USMC; Lance Corporal Kareem M. Nikoui, USMC; and Petty Officer Third Class Maxton W. Soviak, USN.
Here’s how you know @SecKennedy completely dominated CNN: The media hated every word of it. See for yourself. https://t.co/6fVWi33o3J
I'm not surprised Anthony Fauci would repeat Lois Lerner's disgraceful performance. This is no regard for the law and I'm calling for swift accountability. https://t.co/WcQDKDo2We
I was there. Seemed a lot longer.https://t.co/NndcONdO2f
So many federal judges aren’t fair and impartial - just the Trump Resistance in Robes. Here’s @realDonaldTrump calling it out. Read it all. https://t.co/K7dHihZmZ7
Shocking and terrible news. Lindsey Graham was great to know and work with - and he is already missed. https://t.co/m9kjk9En4H https://t.co/ndSNpilhj0

Here’s a message to Gavin Newsom and Rob Bonta: The stakes are too high to weaponize antitrust law and continue to drive away the jobs and economy of California’s entertainment industry. https://t.co/iLBMDdlzlb
What a scoop by @MatthewFoldi https://t.co/wpEh3ZTm1y
A must-read from @FoxNews: A comprehensive report on the troubling details of how American business is treated by our close ally South Korea.   https://t.co/8b6zmwGnWo #FoxNews
I joined the great @MariaBartiromo this morning on @MorningsMaria - that’s the way to start your day: https://t.co/GjtucQUfOn

Powerful and timely statement from @whitehouse: “The U.S. government is deeply concerned about the South Korean government’s discriminatory targeting of U.S. tech companies.”
https://t.co/GzguQGsG9p

South Korea is an ally and partner - but the way it is targeting American businesses and even American citizens is not how friends treat each other.

This report from @JudiciaryGOP is a bombshell. We need to act like it. https://t.co/3Pl8hJVsot
Fake news. Not even close to accurate. Secretary Rubio and Steve Witkoff were thoughtful, responsive, and transparent. They answered all questions. https://t.co/5ye7PfZ6ly
This from @FoxNews is what journalism looks like: Deeply sourced. Asking tough questions. Fair and balanced. Read it all. https://t.co/HN0UpZ5Fd7
The liberal media hasn’t forgotten Fast and Furious. Benghazi, the IRS scandal, Solyndra, and all the rest. They just think you have. https://t.co/8Eyi5erFtF
Epic wins for common sense at the Supreme Court today. The Trump resistance judges have met their match in the Constitution. https://t.co/EDNdHtxGkp

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).
